name: check_drug_interactions
description: Check for drug-drug interactions between a list of medications against a curated interaction database (e.g., Warfarin+Aspirin, Sertraline+Tramadol, Omeprazole+Clopidogrel). Returns severity (major/moderate/minor), mechanism, clinical effects, and management recommendations.

medications.description: JSON array of medication names, e.g. '["Metformin", "Lisinopril", "Warfarin"]' (at least two)

name: assess_symptoms
description: Triage assessment based on reported symptoms, age, and sex. Returns urgency level (EMERGENCY/URGENT/ROUTINE), triage color, differential diagnoses with ICD-10 codes, red flags, and recommended workup. Decision support only.

symptoms.description: Comma-separated list of symptoms (e.g., 'chest pain, shortness of breath, sweating')

name: get_clinical_guidelines
description: Retrieve evidence-based clinical guidelines for a condition: diagnostic criteria, stepwise treatment algorithm, monitoring schedule, and quality measures. Detailed guidelines available for type 2 diabetes and hypertension; other conditions return a generic framework.

name: calculate_risk_score
description: Calculate a clinical risk score for a patient: ASCVD 10-year cardiovascular risk, ADA diabetes risk test, or Morse Fall Scale. Returns score, interpretation, contributing factors, and recommendations.

risk_type.description: Type of risk assessment (One of: cardiovascular, diabetes, falls)
